CREATE TABLE p0_smoke (id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL, happened_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL, payload JSON NOT NULL, normalized_name VARCHAR(64) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (LOWER(name)) STORED, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY p0_smoke_name (name)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
